subject: Fix bug for CLUSTER SLOTS from EVAL over TLS (#1072)
reason: The fix changes clusterCommandSlots' conn_type selection only for a caller with no real connection on the executing client: CLUSTER SLOTS via EVAL/module from a TLS client, or a module call with tls-cluster set. Over plain TCP or a unix socket the old code (fake client's conn==NULL -> not TLS) and the new code (connIsTLS of the real client's TCP connection -> not TLS) compute identical conn_type and byte-identical replies, so any sequence this harness can send is behaviourally identical on both builds and a compared scenario would correctly report unreached-change.
